items.note: The overview describes the product as a B2B note-taking app, and the requirements are written in that context.
The overview names engineering and design leads as the audience for the kickoff, and section 8 lists kickoff next steps for those leads.
Scope and requirements (6.1–6.3) cover creating a workspace, inviting members by email, and shared notes.
Only admin and member roles are defined, and the PRD says 'No other roles exist in v1.'
Billing changes, SSO, and guest access are all listed as out of scope for v1.
The decided metric matches exactly: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days. Extra metrics are marked as proposed and have no targets.
The PRD is about 870 words. That's roughly two pages, though it may run slightly over once formatted. It is still within 'at most about 2 pages.'
Open question 1 asks how existing shared notes migrate into workspaces, and the PRD doesn't answer it. It also adds a second question about sharing across workspaces, which wasn't requested.
